WEBINAR

The Role of Cloud-Native Infrastructure in Payments Modernization

Discover how financial institutions are modernising payments infrastructure using cloud-native platforms. Join FIS and AWS to explore scalable, resilient approaches for supporting real-time payments, reducing integration complexity, improving operational efficiency, and enabling faster innovation without replacing core banking systems.

WHITEPAPER

Set the Standard in Modern Payments

Modernizing payments isn’t just a tech upgrade—it’s a chance to streamline operations, reduce risk, and unlock growth. Learn how FIS and AWS enable secure, scalable cloud-native payments that support real-time processing, simplify operations, and deliver new capabilities without reengineering core systems.

VIDEO

AWS re:Invent 2025 - FIS: High-performance instant payment processing at massive scale

Explore how new instant payment schemes like FedNow and RTP are reshaping performance demands for banks. Learn how FIS built a cloud-native money-movement solution on AWS to enable real-time interbank payments via a unified API, at massive scale.

VIDEO

Transforming Banking: How Real-Time Payments Are Reshaping Financial Services

See how FIS uses AWS to power cloud-native instant payments—meeting demanding uptime, resiliency, and integration requirements. This session explores real-time interbank payments through a unified API, plus orchestration at scale with deep observability and centralized data processing.

Q&A

Transforming payments platforms for a new era

Modernize payments for a real-time world. In this Q&A, FIS’s Ade Sturley explains how Money Movement Hub helps financial institutions move beyond legacy constraints with cloud-native agility, resilience, and scalability—supporting new rails, compliance demands, and faster innovation.

Q&A

Legacy to leading edge: Payments transformation and the future offinancial institutions

Explore how financial institutions can move beyond legacy constraints to deliver secure, always-on payments. This Q&A covers key industry drivers, cloud modernization strategies, and the role of AI and machine learning in fraud detection, observability, and scalability.

WHITEPAPER

Set Money in Motion with Payments Transformation

Discover how FIS and AWS help financial institutions modernize payments. This white paper explores industry challenges, evolving customer expectations, and how the Money Movement Hub supports secure, scalable, future-ready payment infrastructure

WEBINAR

Transforming Payments Platforms for a New Era

North American payments are transforming fast, but banks face legacy tech, regulatory hurdles, and rising expectations. In this Regcast, FIS and AWS discuss modernizing payments with Money Movement Hub—covering key challenges, cloud-native ecosystems, AI, and steps toward a modern platform.

INFOGRAPHIC

Keep up with ever-changing payment schemes

Managing multiple payment schemes is time-consuming and costly. Download our infographic and learn 3 ways on how to unlock strategic growth with the FIS Money Movement Hub.

PRODUCT SHEET

FIS Money Movement Hub factsheet

Managing payments can be complex and costly. Learn how Money Movement Hub simplifies it all with a single API for a full range of U.S schemes. Save time and stay compliant while delivering seamless payment experiences.

BROCHURE

FIS Money Movement Hub Brochure

Struggling to manage multiple payment schemes efficiently? Don’t fall behind in the fast-changing payments landscape Discover how the Money Movement Hub can unlock a single gateway to streamline payment operations reduce costs and stay compliant.
